Card #25666 body and its claim comment (6385224980); PR #25667 body and file list; net diff `origin/main...origin/claude/project-thread-r6oa8t` (2 files, +14/−5, two commits: `c65aab44` then `eb587e5a`, which drops the sentence the first added); the head's check-runs read at 2026-10-24T14:20Z, 2026-10-24T14:21Z and 2026-10-24T14:22Z, and the superseded head `c65aab44`'s at 2026-10-24T14:18Z–2026-10-24T14:20Z; the merge-base `2c523d0100`'s check-runs for the same jobs. Code and docs read on `origin/main` at `2c523d0100e9368ba8af3b08c652f23e943de46a` (the PR's base). Not an input: the dispatch order or the seat's own conclusions; the gate results on the PR body are not used, only the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

Each changed line, judged against the code and docs that must make it true on `main`:

1. `bootstrap.md` L148–L151, L154: five `@objectstack/*` entries `^17.0.0` → `18.1.0` — TRUE on every count. (a) The packages exist under those names: `packages/spec` `@objectstack/spec`, `packages/runtime` `@objectstack/runtime`, `packages/drivers/driver-memory` `@objectstack/driver-memory`, `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server` `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `packages/cli` `@objectstack/cli`. (b) All five manifests read `"version": "18.1.0"` on `main`, and the npm registry's `latest` dist-tag is `18.1.0` for each (plus `create-objectstack` and `@objectstack/skills`). (c) The exact form is what the scaffolder writes: `packages/create-objectstack/src/pkg-utils.ts` `syncObjectStackDeps` sets `deps[dep] = version` for every `@objectstack/` key in `dependencies` and `devDependencies`, header 「EXACT … — no `^`, no `~`, prereleases kept verbatim」 (PR #25539, merged 2026-10-23), called from `src/index.ts` L187 with `readCliVersion()`; `os init` / `os create` standalone do the same through `getCliVersion()` (`init.ts` L29–L33, `create.ts` `objectstackDependencySpec` 「the CLI's own version, EXACT (no `^`/`~`)」). (d) One version for all of them is the lockstep: `.changeset/config.json` puts all five, `create-objectstack` and `@objectstack/skills` in the single `fixed` group. (e) The docs prescribe the form: `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx` L206 「**Pin exact versions** instead of caret ranges … and after 18.0.0 each PATCH as well」; `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` L64 「**Pin the exact version in production**, matching the CLI version in your `package.json`」. The old `^17.0.0` was a major behind and the range the docs refuse. `typescript: ^5.3.0` untouched, as the card asked; it is also the floor `os init` writes (`init.ts` L224, L255).

2. The sentence `c65aab44` added after the block (「`npx create-objectstack` writes every `@objectstack/*` dependency as its own version, exactly (no caret) — keep all `@objectstack/*` packages on that one version」) was TRUE by 1(c)–(d) and spelt the command as the file's own 〈Scaffolding Command〉 does (L81, L84 `npx create-objectstack`), but it is no longer in the diff: `eb587e5a` removes it. The head's prose is byte-for-byte `main`'s; only the five version strings differ.

3. Token-ratchet resolution — VERIFIED. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` `CEILINGS` L679 pins `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` at 1351, shrink-only, and the file sits at zero headroom on `main`: 5403 bytes, `ceil(5403/4)` = 1351 (the script's own stated hand audit, header 「INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCIBLE」: ceil of the file's `wc -c` byte count over 4; nothing was run). `c65aab44` grew the file by the sentence and the gate step 「Published skills token ratchet (#10473) + its self-test」 in `Type Check · source gates` went red (annotation at 2026-10-24T14:18Z; the merge-base's `Type Check · source gates` run is green, so the red was this PR's, not a base signature). `eb587e5a` is 5398 bytes, `ceil(5398/4)` = 1350 ≤ 1351: each `^17.0.0` → `18.1.0` is one byte shorter, five bytes in all, so the head is one unit under its ceiling. Dropping the sentence instead of asking for a raise is the right remedy: the ratchet header 「New text is paid for by DELETING text in the SAME FILE … Going the other way lands only in a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling」, and the ceiling file is maintainer-only. No ceiling row changed.

4. Sweep of `skills/**` on the head: `git grep -n '"\^1[0-9]\.' skills/` is empty (the card's acceptance line); no `@objectstack/…` entry with a caret range anywhere in `skills/**`; no other `17.0.0` package-version example. The only `^17` left is `engines: { protocol: '^17' }` (`objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142, its eval `config-plugins-ops.json` L7, and `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89/L91) — the metadata-protocol handshake range, a different value from the package version, as the card says; its own staleness is ③.2.

5. Card acceptance read against the head: the caret grep is empty (above); `check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:skill-compatibility` run in `Type Check · source gates`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness` in `Lint · docs & code guards`, `check:skill-frame-freshness` beside frame-sync — their conclusions are those jobs' check-runs (CI state below). Commit trailers model-free (`Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Claude-Session:`); PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed.

CI on this head (last read 2026-10-24T14:22Z, 45 check-runs): success — Governed Surface Queue Guard, filter, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, No other open PR may claim the same issue, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path, Part-of PR must not also close its card, Auto Label, Check PR Size, Check Changeset (both runs), Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test Core (3/6), Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · workspace, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure. In progress — Type Check · source gates (hosts the token ratchet, frame-sync and skill-compatibility), Type Check · consumer gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Build Core, Test Core (1/6, 2/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6). Skipped (path-filtered or opt-in) — Dogfood Verify CLI, Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Regression Gate shards, 18.x upgrade harness, Packed-tarball smoke, and the duplicate Auto Label / Check PR Size rows. One cancelled row: a first Governed Surface Queue Guard run, superseded by the in-progress one on the same head. No red on this head at any read; the only red in the PR's history is `c65aab44`'s token ratchet, resolved as in ①.3. This verdict is on the diff; landing waits for every in-progress and queued run to conclude green, `Type Check · source gates` first among them.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch — right. `skills/**` is the source of `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills`; `pr-automation.yml` L861 「a 'skills/**' change releases '@objectstack/skills' and never takes the label」), so a changeset is owed and the package named is the one that ships the file. Five version strings in a documentation example widen no accepted set and no public face: `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the changeset holds; `Metadata-protocol: none` holds (no schema, no manifest field, no conversion). The reworded changeset body matches the head (no claim of an added sentence; 「the exact form `create-objectstack` writes, with all of them on one version」 is ①.1(c)–(d)).

### ③ Boundary flags

1. Card 〈Wanted〉 half not delivered, declared: the card asked for the five pins AND 「one prose line says the scaffolder writes its own version exactly and every `@objectstack/*` package stays on the same one」. The head delivers the pins only; the sentence is unfunded under the shrink-only ceiling (①.3) and the PR body says so in both its 维护者速读 and 〈What changed〉. The card's machine 〈Acceptance〉 (empty caret grep, four gates) is met. If the lane still wants the sentence, it is paid for by deleting text elsewhere in `bootstrap.md` (one unit of headroom today) — a skills-lane choice, not this review's; 「Fixes #25666」 closes the card with the body's statement as the record of the half left out.

2. `engines: { protocol: '^17' }` — out of this PR's scope by the card, correctly described as a different value, but itself STALE and worth a card: `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` has `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '18.0.0'` (`PROTOCOL_MAJOR` 18), and the handshake refuses a range that excludes the runtime major (`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` L548 「fails boot fast with the structured OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE diagnostic」), so an app that copies `'^17'` from `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142 is refused at boot by an 18.x runtime. The scaffolders already write `'^18'` (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` L39; `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` L869 `'^${PROTOCOL_MAJOR}'`; all five `examples/**` carry `'^18'`), while SKILL.md L147 says `create-objectstack` stamps the value shown. Also stale on the same value: `objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L7 and `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89 (「scaffold and example writes the caret form (`engines: { protocol: '^17' }`)」). No gate catches it: `check:skill-compatibility` reconciles only the frontmatter `compatibility:` and `metadata.version` lines, and `sync-protocol-version.mjs` stamps the constant, not `skills/**`. No open `domain:skills` card carries it (the open set was read; only #25666 mentions `^17`). `'^17'` → `'^18'` is byte-neutral, so the ratchet does not block it. Flag only: a `domain:skills` filing-gate ② card, not a blocker here.

3. `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts` L175–L178 comment (「so `^` plus the scaffolder's own version always resolves」 — the caret form) is stale against `syncObjectStackDeps` (`domain:devx`, not this PR). Carrier exists: PR #25665 (open, `Fixes #25510`) rewrites it to 「own exact version」, caret gone, in its `index.ts` hunk. Nothing owed from this PR.

4. The literal `18.1.0` ages with each release and nothing restamps it: the ratchet's one exclusion is the frontmatter `metadata.version` stamp line, and `check:skill-compatibility --fix` rewrites only the frontmatter pins, so a prose/code-block version string is hand-kept. Already stated on the PR body; recorded so the next release's reader knows no gate will red on it. The card's own alternative (a range) is what the docs refuse, so the exact literal is still the right choice.

5. `c65aab44` (superseded): its red was this PR's and is resolved by `eb587e5a`; the base's `Type Check · source gates` run at `2c523d0100` is green, so nothing on `main` is bleeding.
